services_shape: set services with a chosen nail tech; the length is set by the service and by what's on the nails now (a removal adds time); a pedicure also books one of the salon's pedicure chairs
questions_before_times: hands, feet or both, and which services
what's on the nails now: nothing, gel, dip or acrylic, and from this salon or another (a removal adds time and price)
nail art: none, a little, or a custom design (design photos for a custom set)
which nail tech, or the first one free
for a bridal party or a nail party: how many people, and the date
safety_stop: an allergic reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, or hard to breathe
nail glue, acetone or another product in the eye
first_steps: none: nail work needs no first visit
license: always: nail work (nail technology, manicuring or cosmetology, by the state's own name) is licensed where the state's rules require it
staff_skills: manicure, pedicure, gel, dip, acrylic, nail art, custom art, lashes and brows; only nail techs who do custom art are offered for it
messages_never: diabetes, infection, sore, reaction and allergy answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
